messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary cohort "cohort-9" p95 +50% for /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1. Auto-rollback recommended. https://ops.redwood/telemetry/cohort-9 :rotating_light:

anya: noticed. this started right after a kernel tweak for attention caching. any dedicated pools pinned?

matt: no dedicated pins. it's ~8% of hosted traffic. i rolled the kernel tweak back on two hosts but latency still high.

anya: i'd rather manual rollback so we can draft release notes and avoid auto-email churn. holding auto-rollback for 8m. tagging kate for comms.

kate: understood. if we revert, we'll use the short template and only notify customers if dedicated pools were affected or errors occurred. prepping snippet.

sre-oncall: watching dashboards. if p95 doesn't drop 3m after rollback, we escalate to infra.

matt: executing pin to stop rollout spread: 
```
releasectl pin --service=hosted --region=eu-west-1 --version 1.9.7
```

matt: initiating targeted rollback of cohort-9 now: 
```
rolloutctl revert --group cohort-9 --to 1.9.7 --by matt
```

sre-oncall: p95 back to normal within minutes. holding for 20m observation.

kate: release note draft:

"We reverted a canary cohort in eu-west-1 for /v1/embeddings due to increased latency after an attention-caching kernel change. Impact: brief latency increase for a small segment of hosted traffic. No dedicated customers were affected. No action required. Postmortem to follow."

anya: closing thread after monitoring window. thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
